{{Top|leg}}
'''Razorvine''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could be found growing on low-hanging branches in [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], covering them. Jagged and sharp, it added to the danger posed by these branches for those who ran into them.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
